rules.tool_inclusion: Monthly service fees include standard software and infrastructure within the listed service limits. No separate standard tool fee.
rules.scope_limit: Before exceeding limits, agree a new bundled tier. Never invent overage rates or silently add charges. Where a hard cap is possible, stop at the cap; monitoring and client communication are still required.
exceptions: Premium or high-renewal domains outside the standard allowance
rules.estimate: Informational estimate, valid 30 days, subject to requirements, availability and owner confirmation. From items produce a starting estimate, never a fixed total.
rules.discounts: Only owner-approved discounts with explicit SKU, amount and duration. Jasper cannot independently waive setup or change monthly prices.
rules.setup: Installation products have listed setup fees unless explicitly included in another product. Onboarding-only fees apply only when listed. Do not invent setup charges for advisory sessions or already included functionality.
rules.cancellation: Proposed add-ons are month-to-month, with cancellation before next renewal. Annual third-party commitments are internal costs unless explicitly agreed otherwise. Do not change an existing customer agreement.
rules.billing: Essential development: 50% to start and 50% on completion. Add-on charges begin at activation. Enterprise billing, minimum term, ownership and continued support are defined in its proposal. Existing agreements retain their terms.
rules.included_support: Support allowances are per calendar month and do not roll over. They cover the installed configuration; new features, content production and major revisions are excluded. Additional work is quoted and agreed before starting. Existing agreements remain in effect.
rules.hosting: Feature add-ons do not include the base website hosting unless expressly stated. Determine whether the customer already has suitable hosting. Do not force a new website purchase for standalone email, scheduling or domains.
rules.exclusions: No general copywriting, photography/video production, social content creation or review responses. Campaign ad text is included only in PPC.
rules.custom_work: Custom project prices are starting estimates until requirements and delivery are confirmed.
rules.assistant_status: No live Jasper chat or customer-facing estimate builder is active. This reference can be explicitly loaded by a future assistant. Presence of this page does not connect or train an AI.
rules.website_options: New projects use Essential as the defined starting website, plus scoped additions, or Enterprise for an individually scoped larger project. Growth is legacy only. Enterprise requires a custom quote; do not invent a starting price.
rules.readiness: This is a proposed comprehensive menu. Existing fixed entries still require scope confirmation; new or unbuilt capabilities require implementation and supplier-cost validation before a final offer. A starting price is not proof that a system is already built.
rules.internal_guidance: Off-menu work requires a requirements brief and owner-reviewed estimate. Internal effort guidance is supplied separately to a future server-side assistant and is not part of this public-readable reference.
rules.overlap: Ask which site/location/workflow is shared. Included child capabilities are not separately charged for the same work. Missing prerequisites, excess usage, or ambiguous overlaps must be resolved before presenting a complete estimate.
rules.quote_presentation: Customer estimates show build/setup, monthly service, applicable commitments, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. No itemized internal time rate or internal minimum is displayed.
rules.portfolio: Future portfolio examples must describe what a comparable configuration would cost today, dated and scoped; never expose client invoices. Price each example from current catalog IDs and quantities. Jasper may start from these examples once they exist, but no examples are currently connected.
rules.needs_first: Lead with the smallest complete solution. Keep optional services separate. Never automatically bundle local SEO or monitoring because a customer asks to be found. Assess existing email and aliases. Discuss paid search for time-bound demand after clarifying intent, geography, capacity, budget and measurement; it does not replace organic search setup.
rules.seo_deliverables: Extra SEO must identify paid work: existing-site assessment, profile creation, listing corrections, or agreed technical/information-structure fixes. Never resell Essential search foundation on the same build. Ongoing SEO requires an assessed recurring backlog and explicit deliverables; do not default to the $395 service. Do not stack included profile maintenance or monitoring.
